title: plugin-security + runtime: the grant, clone and activation doors take a permission set's package and report a two-holder name with its candidates (ADR-0150 D3/D8; before #31698 PR-2)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzeeBmtefMTT21doena

Filed verbatim by seat 3 from the epic seat's draft (`epic:#31527#1`, /mnt/project-files/epic-31527/31698-carriers.md), with the maintainer's approval on seat 3's decision card (option 「允许，3 号席位立卡」, 2026-11-10, this account's project thread). ⛔ Not a claim.
Ruling-ref: 6764938596 (epic, on #31698: ruling A agreed, the carrier rulings); seat 3 step-0 ruling on #31698.

④ coordination card: a child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527, a precondition of #31698 PR-2.

**Epic:** ADR-0150 (#31527). **Blocks:** #31698 (PR-2). **Lane:** `domain:server` (plugin-security, runtime). **Reader:** the server seat that claims it.
**Found by** #31698 PR-2 step 0 (seat 3, M1–M5). Readings: `/mnt/project-files/server-orders/seat3/31698-step0.md`.

### The doors read a refusal as "no such set", and none can name a package

These doors pick nothing, so they fail closed. But with two holders, no door can grant, clone or switch off either set, and each reports the ambiguity as a miss. Red line 2 says ambiguity is reported.

| # | Door | Today (two holders, measured) | Do |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| M1 | `grant-permission-set-name.ts` (`catalog.resolve`): Setup's grant form and the data door | `400 reference_not_found`, "There is no permission set named …" | Report the D3 refusal with its candidates (the 409 shape). Accept `permission_set_package` and resolve by it |
| M2 | `stored-permission-set-package-stamp.ts` (the #31698 PR-1 seam) | an insert replaces any package the writer sent, and stamps `null` for a two-holder name | A writer that names a package keeps it when that package holds the name. A named package that does not hold it is refused, never re-stamped |
| M3 | `permission-set-clone.ts` (`reader.resolve`) | `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, "nothing to clone" | 409 with the candidates; take a source package |
| M4 | `catalog-activation.ts` (`reader.resolve`) | `404`, "nothing to switch off"; no ledger row is written | 409 with the candidates; take a package and write that package's ledger row |
| M5 | `sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` unique index `(user_id, permission_set, organization_id)` | one user cannot hold both holders' sets in one organization | see the index ruling below |

**Index ruling (epic seat).** The unique key gains `permission_set_package` and becomes `(user_id, permission_set, permission_set_package, organization_id)`. This is additive under red line 3: rows that duplicate each other under the old key still duplicate under the new one.
- **Null semantics on every driver.** Two grants of one name with a **null** package, for one user in one organization, must stay refused. SQL drivers treat NULLs as distinct in a unique index, so normalize to a sentinel or use the driver's null-equal form. Mongo follows the #31732 widened-unique precedent. Pin it per driver.
- **Migration.** It is re-runnable. Existing rows keep their values, and no row is rewritten with a guessed package.

**Clause-②:** the seat declares it. With one holder, every door answers as today. First-party census: 0 pairs.
**Dedupe** (open and closed, `permission-set-clone package`, `sys_user_permission_set unique index package`): the hits are older clone-door and grant-UI cards (#28563, #28573, #23430, #30208). None of them takes a package or reports a two-holder name.
**Business reason:** without this, after the narrowing, an administrator cannot grant, clone or switch off either of two same-named sets shipped by two packages.
**Epic red-line review before landing.**
